method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module (built-in date functions, no daydate), the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; one regulative rule (apply for rectification within 6 months, s 12A (3)) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Wills Act 1968 (ACT), A1968-11, Republication No 22 (R22), effective 23 February 2026, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1968-11.txt

seat: the person claiming under or about a will: a beneficiary or would-be beneficiary, a member of the will-maker's family, the executor named, the former spouse or partner, and the person applying to the Supreme Court (rectification, a will for someone without testamentary capacity, a child asking to make or revoke a will) (wills-claims.l4)
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: validity of a will and of changes to it, the court's dispensing, rectification and statutory-will powers and their time limits, revocation by marriage and divorce, revocation and revival, 30-day survival and gifts to issue

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run wills-dates.l4 ; l4 run wills-claims.l4 ; l4 run wills-cases.l4
checks.result: 154 assertions written, 154 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: s 8, 8A, 8B, 9, 10, 11A, 12, 12A, 12B, 15C, 15D (1) (a), (b), 15H, 16 (1), (6), (7), 16A (1), (3), 16B (1), 16C (1), 16E, 16F, 16I, 16K (one fact), 20, 20A, 21, 22 (1), (3), 31, 31B, 31C, 35 (2); folded into wording: ss 13-15, 18, 19, 9 (2), 10 (3), 20A (3), 31C (4). Out: ss 5, 7, 11, 14A, 17; Part 2A machinery (15A, 15B, 15D (1) (c), (2), 15E-15G); Part 3A and 3B procedure (16 (2)-(5), 16A (2), (4)-(7), 16B (2), 16C (2), 16D, 16G, 16H, 16J, 16L, 16M, schedule 1 articles); construction rules ss 23-30A, 31A; remoter issue s 31 (3), 31B (3); grounds of rectification s 12A (1), (2) (left to the court); ss 32, 33, 35 (1). Reasons in NOTES.md.
